run_map_kelm_cli: run the map_kelm CLI to parse JSONL references and resolve Wikidata entities to an output file
run_resolve_first_ref: run resolve_first_ref to parse a reference string into subject relation object Wikidata triples
run_resolve_later_ref: run resolve_later_ref to parse a subsequent reference string given an existing subject entity
run_try_recovery: run try_recovery to attempt recovering a Wikidata entity ID from a malformed or uncleaned name string
run_find_longest_match: run find_longest_match to find the longest matching Wikidata entity or relation from a list of search candidates
